"""Content-exact GitHub API source snapshot while preserving local history."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,subprocess,datetime,hashlib
from archive import api,ROOT,DOC,OUT,write

def main():
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'Commit tracked changes first'
    local=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip();target=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    remote=api('GET','git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'];meta=api('GET','git/commits/'+remote)
    if meta['tree']['sha']==target:print(json.dumps(dict(state='ALREADY_CONTENT_IDENTICAL',remote_commit=remote)));return
    # All local commits must build on current remote; don't overwrite divergent edits.
    subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','-e',remote+'^{commit}'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',remote,local],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    names=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--no-renames','--name-only',remote,local],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines();tree=[]
    for p in names:
        assert not p.startswith('stage/runs/') and Path(p).suffix not in ('.pt','.npz','.gz','.mp4','.zip'),p
        exists=subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','-e',local+':'+p],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True).returncode==0
        if not exists:
            oldmode=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree',remote,'--',p],cwd=ROOT,text=True).split()[0]
            tree.append(dict(path=p,mode=oldmode,type='blob',sha=None));continue
        b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',local+':'+p],cwd=ROOT);assert len(b)<2*1024**2
        mode=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree',local,'--',p],cwd=ROOT,text=True).split()[0]
        tree.append(dict(path=p,mode=mode,type='blob',content=b.decode()))
    obj=api('POST','git/trees',dict(base_tree=meta['tree']['sha'],tree=tree));assert obj['sha']==target
    commit=api('POST','git/commits',dict(message='Synchronize verified Stage source and bounded experiment outcomes\n\nContent-exact local '+local+'. Raw models/trajectories live in Release, not Git. Preserve all failure evidence; no Phase research or runtime planner.',tree=target,parents=[remote]))
    now=api('GET','git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'];assert now==remote,'Remote moved; inspect before updating'
    api('PATCH','git/refs/heads/main',dict(sha=commit['sha'],force=False))
    ref=api('GET','git/ref/heads/main');final=api('GET','git/commits/'+commit['sha']);assert ref['object']['sha']==final['sha'] and final['tree']['sha']==target
    # Rebuild only exact remote commit bytes to reconcile local histories.
    tzs=['+0800','+0000'];matched=False
    for tz in tzs:
        def person(p):
            stamp=int(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(p['date'].replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp());return f"{p['name']} <{p['email']}> {stamp} {tz}"
        raw='tree '+target+'\n'+''.join('parent '+p['sha']+'\n' for p in final['parents'])+'author '+person(final['author'])+'\ncommitter '+person(final['committer'])+'\n\n'+final['message']
        for suffix in ('','\n'):
            b=(raw+suffix).encode();sha=hashlib.sha1(b'commit '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
            if sha==final['sha']:
                subprocess.run(['git','hash-object','-w','-t','commit','--stdin'],cwd=ROOT,input=b,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                subprocess.run(['git','update-ref','refs/remotes/origin/main',sha],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
                subprocess.run(['git','merge','--no-edit','-m','Preserve local Stage history alongside verified API source snapshot',sha],cwd=ROOT,check=True);matched=True;break
        if matched:break
    assert matched,'Remote source verified but local commit encoding unrecovered; inspect before any further sync'
    write(OUT/'latest_source_sync_receipt.json',dict(state='REMOTE_HEAD_AND_FULL_ROOT_TREE_VERIFIED',local_source_commit=local,remote_commit=final['sha'],root_tree=target,changed_files=len(names),url=final['html_url'],raw_binary_in_git=False))
    print(json.dumps(dict(state='SOURCE_SYNC_VERIFIED',url=final['html_url'],files=len(names))))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

from pathlib import Path
import io,time,json,ast
import learning as M
L,torch=M.L,M.torch

def main():
    p=M.config();M.setup();train,test=M.data(p);obj=M.make(p);before=L.digest(M.state(obj));rng=M.np.random.default_rng(p['learner_seed']);pack=M.pack(train,rng,p);value=M.loss(obj[0],pack,'aware');value.backward();assert bool(torch.isfinite(value));nz=sum(int(torch.count_nonzero(v.grad)) for v in obj[0].parameters());assert nz>0
    assert L.digest(M.state(obj))==before
    s=M.state(obj)
    for i,v in zip(s['optimizer']['param_groups'][0]['params'],obj[0].parameters()):s['optimizer']['state'][i]=dict(step=torch.tensor(1.),exp_avg=torch.zeros_like(v).cpu(),exp_avg_sq=torch.zeros_like(v).cpu())
    b=io.BytesIO();torch.save(dict(state=s,state_sha='0'*64),b);upper=int(len(b.getvalue())*1.001)+32768;assert upper<p['checkpoint_bytes']
    # Return recursion and finite-task terminal mask, including timeout.
    for e in train+test:
        assert e['bootstrap'][-1]==0 and e['ret'][-1]==e['r'][-1]
        assert torch.equal(e['ret'][:-1],e['r'][:-1]+e['discount'][:-1]*e['bootstrap'][:-1]*e['ret'][1:])
    for f in M.HERE.glob('*.py'):ast.parse(f.read_text())
    report=dict(state='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE_ZERO_OPTIMIZER',train_episodes=len(train),holdout_episodes=len(test),train_ids=sorted({e['id'] for e in train}),holdout_ids=sorted({e['id'] for e in test}),split_by_whole_task_id=True,full_history_BPTT=True,return_labels_are_recorded_behavior_not_current_policy_Q=True,nonzero_gradient_entries=nz,checkpoint_safe_upper=upper,actor_not_created_or_updated=True,no_Adam_step=True,epoch=time.time());L.save(M.DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json',report);print(json.dumps(report))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""RAM-only archive after every science writer is stopped; no training imports."""
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import time

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t622_gpu_critic_calibration'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_t606_archive',ROOT/'stage/experiments/t493_wide8_night/transport.py')
A=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(A)


def stopped():
    j=json.loads((OUT/'SEALED.json').read_text())
    assert j['all_scientific_processes_stopped']
    assert all(not Path('/proc',str(i)).exists() for i in j['scientific_pids'])


def main():
    A.OLD.install();T=A.OLD.T
    import urllib.request
    T.B.OPENER=urllib.request.build_opener()
    if sys.argv[1]=='source_sync':
        import t622_sync_source
        t622_sync_source.main();return
    assert sys.argv[1]=='T622';stopped();A.stopped=stopped
    original=T.B.write
    def write(path,value):
        if Path(path).name=='source_manifest_T622.json':
            value=dict(value,scope='Ended Stage T622 action-aware versus action-blind recorded behavior-return prediction; frozen Actor; zero native or Actor updates; no policy-Q certification')
        return original(path,value)
    T.B.write=write
    p=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text())
    release=T.B.api('GET','releases/tags/stage-eight-only-2026-11-11')
    files=sorted(f for f in OUT.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f.name!='driver.log' and f.suffix not in ['.lock','.pyc','.partial'])
    deadline=min(time.time()+p['transport_seconds']-10,p['absolute_all_stop']-30)
    r=A.archive('T622',files,release,deadline,T)
    stopped();assert r['state']=='FULL_REMOTE_READBACK_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_SHA_VERIFIED'
    print('T622_FULL_RAW_BACKUP_PASS',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
